_about: Handwritten masses (g) on the 3D-printed parts, read off five photos the user sent on 2026-08-23 and matched to CAD parts by shape + location + mass ratio. PLA at 100% infill is 1.24/2.70 = 0.46 of the aluminium CAD mass; anything above that is a misread or a misassignment. Confidence: high = shape and number unambiguous; med = shape fits, pair-mate (A/B) or side not provable from the photo; low = reading or shape uncertain - verify against the part in hand. Second batch (photos 6-10, 2026-08-23) added Body4, HipYaw2Knee_outer, the ankle mount plates, the long shin truss, the foot plate and the hip-pitch D-plate, and corrected 67 -> 67.3.
